$comment: Request body of POST /provisioning/v1/customerOrder (bss/provisioning, ADR-0382). This is the project's own OAM API, not a 3GPP/TMF DTO: there is no struct to derive from, so this file is hand-transcribed from the request-shape comment in bss/provisioning/src/provisioning_store.hpp and the reads/validation in provisioning_store.cpp. gui/schema-gen/check_provisioning_schema.py re-derives every key, pattern, required field and enum from those sources (and the charging DB CHECK constraints) and fails ctest on any drift (ADR-0421).
title: CustomerOrder

idempotencyKey.description: Resending the same key resumes the same order (saga, ADR-0382) instead of creating a second one.

segment.description: Enum from the charging DB CHECK on subscriber_mgmt.account.account_kind; service default CONSUMER.

chargingMode.description: Enum from the charging DB CHECK on subscriber_mgmt.subscriber.charging_mode; service default PREPAID.

productOfferingId.description: Id of an existing TMF620 ProductOffering (foreign key; an unknown id fails the BSS task).

usageType.description: Service default 'monetary'. Documented values monetary|voice|data|sms|other come from a column comment only (40-balance.sql), not a CHECK, so they are not enforced as an enum.

sim.title: SIM credentials (never logged, never stored by the GUI or its proxy)

k.description: Subscriber key K, 32 hex digits (SIM vendor input file).

opc.description: OPc, 32 hex digits (SIM vendor input file).
